nativeRelease.scope: Native Windows release, synthetic fixtures. No screen-reader certification, external-editor launch, provider inference or universal accessibility claim.

onboarding: Real first-use five-step tour keeps draft/access and creates no account/session or model request
Opening explanations leaves backend access unchanged; explicit file-edit selection persists through actual IPC and reload
Tour replay from native settings exits by Escape with usable focus and no messages
composer: Text and attachments stay with their chat, including New conversation
Immediate pending bubble, single send, stable client ID and no late draft/chat overwrite
Rejection restores the source draft and preserves newer text; no replay
Uncertain readback is checked without resend, duplicate or draft overwrite
Rejected send with failed first readback remains recoverable after checking delivery
New-chat creation keeps its optimistic message and follow-up draft isolated
Delayed Compact preserves newer source text and does not navigate away from another chat
execution: Pending native question is distinct from silence and clears after the real answer
Promise-only response ends with zero tool evidence; diagnostics survive reload
Explicit tool start/end is observed without treating a completed result as still running
Provider failure is separate from normal return and no request is replayed
Actual 30-second silence is visible, status refresh is read-only, explicit Stop cancels without restart
Delayed read-only status refresh cannot overwrite another chat or its draft
Internal Orchestra interview keeps provider observations after save/reload
Persisted interruption is readable after reload in Italian/dark theme
